html:
With over 100 beautiful and modern golf courses, the Philippine golf tour is a must-experience for enthusiasts. From golf courses in Manila to those on stunning islands like Palawan and Boracay. The Philippines offers a variety of golf courses to cater to every preference and skill level.

The Philippine golf tour is sure to provide exciting experiences for golfers; combining breathtaking natural landscapes with professional golf courses. Let’s learn more about some famous golf courses in the Philippines and prepare for an exceptional golf experience there.

Top 5 Philippine Golf Tour Courses

To have a perfect Philippine golf tour, you should seek out the most suitable golf courses in the country. Here is a list of the most renowned local golf courses for you:

Manila Southwoods Golf And Country Club

Topping the Philippine golf tour list, you can consider the Manila Southwoods Golf. It is a famous golf course in the Philippines and is ranked number one in the Southeast Asian region.

Located in Carmona City, Cavite province, approximately a 30-minute drive from Manila city center; this golf course covers 140 hectares with 36 challenging holes. You cannot miss this Manila golf club with countless exciting features.

Jack Nicklaus is the designer of the Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club, one of the world’s legendary golf stars. The golf course is divided into the West and the East Course.

The West Course consists of 18 holes and is considered the more challenging part, with various hazards and hilly terrains. On the other hand, the East Course has another 18 holes and is more suitable for beginners.

Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club feature two main golf courses: the Legends Course and the Master’s Course.

The Legends Course is the original golf course of Manila Southwoods, built-in 1992. Designed by Jack Nicklaus, it is considered the most challenging golf course in the Philippines.

This golf course has the largest area within Manila Southwoods, spanning 66 hectares. The Legends Course offers varying slopes and obstacles, such as water hazards and forests.

The Masters Course was built later in 1996 and also consisted of 18 holes. Designed by Jack Nicklaus, it provides a different golfing experience compared to the Legends Course. The Masters Course has longer and narrower fairways than the Legends Course, with challenging water hazards and grassy areas.

In addition, Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club offer modern facilities; such as practice areas, restaurants, a gym, a spa area, and conference centers to cater to customers’ needs.

With picturesque golf courses, stunning landscapes, and challenging designs; Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club have captured the attention of many top golfers worldwide. It is undoubtedly a destination to be noticed for golf enthusiasts on the Philippine golf tour.

The Orchard Golf And Country Club

Arnold Palmer and Gary Player, golf legends, have designed two world-class 18-hole, par-72 golf courses at The Orchard Golf. It is located in the affluent Dasmariñas urban site on Metro Manila’s outskirts.

In 2020, Golf Digest USA voted The Orchard Golf, the second-best golf club in the Philippines.

The Orchard Golf Club is renowned for its breathtaking scenery and is located about an hour and a half south of Manila. It is a premier golf course in the Philippines, with two championship courses: Arnold Palmer and Gary Player.

These two golf courses have hosted many national and international competitions. Some featured contests:

  • Johnnie Walker Classic 1995
  • The World Golf Tour 1996

The golf courses here are also divided into different sections for players to choose from on their golf tours:

  • The East Course features long fairways and narrow flat fairways, with water hazards and forested areas posing various challenges.
  • The West Course is the most difficult section, with hilly terrain and challenging fairways, providing a true challenge for golfers.
  • The South Course is the easiest section, suitable for beginners. Those who want to practice their golf skills can also practice here.

The Orchard Golf and Country Club also offers modern facilities; such as practice areas, performance areas, restaurants, fitness gyms, and spas. Visitors on a Philippine golf tour will enjoy numerous excellent amenities. It is currently attracting top golfers from around the world.

Wack Wack Golf

Wack Wack Golf is one of the top golf course choices when visiting the Philippines. This course is the most famous and oldest golf course in the Philippines.

Located in Mandaluyong City, Metro Manila; the golf course was established in 1930 and has hosted international golf tournaments.

Wack Wack Golf features two main golf courses: the East and West. The East Course is the original golf course, designed by renowned golf architect William J. Shaw.

With 18 holes and hilly terrain, the East Course is famous for its picturesque fairways and challenging hazards. Many international tournaments have been held here, including the 2008 Philippine Open.

The West Course is the second golf course at Wack Wack, designed by Robbie McFarland. With 18 holes and relatively flat fairways, the West Course offers a different golfing experience than the East Course. This golf course has also hosted various national and international golf tournaments.

Wack Wack Golf and Country Club is a destination for golfers and a premier club with additional amenities; such as swimming pools, fitness gyms, tennis courts, and restaurants. The club is also famous for its distinctive clubhouse architecture, creating an elegant and sophisticated ambiance.

With its long-standing history, beautiful design, and quality fairways, Wack Wack Golf and Country Club will provide you an exciting Philippine golf tour experience.

Mount Malarayat Golf

Mount Malarayat Golf and Country Club is a renowned golf course in the Philippines, located in Lipa City, Batangas province. Built on a large plot of land and situated in a hilly area; Mount Malarayat Golf offers a scenic and enjoyable golf experience.

Mount Malarayat Golf features a main course with 27 holes. The course is divided into three sections: The Mount, The Lagoon, and The Plains, each with its characteristics and challenges.

The Mount is the highest part of Mount Malarayat Golf. Located on the hill, this section offers breathtaking scenery and winding fairways on hilly terrain. With the hilly landscape, golfers will face changing slopes and directions, creating an interesting challenge.

The Lagoon features a water lagoon and lush green grass areas. The golf course runs along the water; golfers will feel peaceful and relaxed when playing here. The hazards in this section include water ponds and challenging grassy areas.

Golfers can make shots that require technique and precision. Participants in the Philippine golf tour here can enjoy the refreshing natural surroundings while playing golf.

The Plains is the largest and flattest part of Mount Malarayat Golf. The fairways here are spacious and free of narrow paths, providing favorable conditions for strong and confident shots.

This section is considered the easiest to play on the golf course and a popular choice for beginners or those looking to hone their skills.

Mount Malarayat Golf is famous for its beautiful natural landscapes and the unique architecture of its clubhouse. It offers additional amenities like restaurants, swimming pools, and fitness areas.

With its stunning natural scenery, exciting golf courses, and top-notch facilities, Mount Malarayat Golf will provide you with a perfect Philippine golf tour.

The Riviera Golf Club

The Riviera Golf Club is a renowned golf course in the Philippines in Silang City, Cavite province. Established in 1988, the golf course has become a popular destination for golfers, both local and international.

The Riviera Golf Club features two main golf courses: The Langer Course and The Couples Course.

  • The Langer Course: This course is designed by Bernhard Langer, one of the world’s top golfers and a two-time Masters Tournament champion. The Langer Course offers a world-class golf experience. With 18 holes and hilly terrain, this golf course demands accuracy and high-level shooting skills. It features natural hazards such as water ponds, streams, and forests.
  • The Couples Course: Designed by Fred Couples, a renowned golfer and Major Tournament champion, The Couples Course provides a unique golfing experience. With 18 holes, this golf course has relatively flat and spacious fairways, providing favorable conditions for golfers. Natural and strategically placed artificial hazards add to the challenge.

These courses will provide golfers with an exceptional Philippine golf tour experience. With world-class design and breathtaking scenery, The Riviera Golf Club is a fantastic destination for your pro golf events.

5 Major Golf Tournaments in the Philippines in

Golf in the Philippines is truly exciting, with many captivating tournaments. Here are some prominent golf tournaments in the country:

TCC Invitational

The TCC Invitational golf tournament in the Philippines is a significant event in the country’s golf calendar. TCC stands for “The Country Club,” a renowned golf club in the Philippines.

The TCC Invitational attracts top golfers from both domestic and international scenes. It is an opportunity for professional and amateur golfers to compete against each other in a competitive and prestigious environment.

Detailed information about the TCC Invitational, including schedules, regulations, and winners, is usually provided on The Country Club’s website. You can also find updates through reliable golf news sources.

It is an opportunity for golfers to explore beautiful golf courses and challenge their skills in a professional setting.

PGT Qualifying School

The PGT (Philippine Golf Tour) Qualifying School is a significant event in the Philippine golf calendar. It is a qualifying tournament for golfers seeking opportunities to join the professional circuit of the PGT.

The PGT Qualifying School takes place annually and serves as a platform for golfers to compete to earn a PGT professional card. This card lets them participate in official tournaments and compete with top golfers in the Philippines.

In the PGT Qualifying School, golfers go through a series of rounds and are assessed based on their skills and performance. Based on the results, a limited number of PGT professional cards are awarded to the most outstanding golfers.

Participating in the PGT Qualifying School allows golfers to showcase their talents and abilities. It is also the first step to embark on a professional journey in the golf industry in the Philippines.

ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic

Furthermore, the ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic is a professional golf tournament within the Philippine Golf Tour (PGT) circuit in the Philippines. This tournament takes place annually and is held in the province of Negros Occidental; located in the western part of the Negros Island.

The ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic attracts top professional golfers from both domestic and international scenes. The tournament allows golfers to compete and experience a professional golfing environment. You can compete against other golfers on the golf course to vie for victory and prizes.

This tournament brings joy and excitement to participating golfers and contributes to developing and enhancing golf quality in the Philippines.

ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge

The ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge is a professional golf tournament held in the Philippines. It is organized by ICTSI (International Container Terminal Services, Inc.); a leading transportation and port services conglomerate in the Philippines. The tournament attracts top professional golfers from worldwide.

ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge takes place in Iloilo City, a location in the Visayas region of the Philippines. This tournament allows golfers to compete and vie for victory and prizes on the golf course.

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship is a professional golf tournament organized in the Philippines. It is sponsored by ICTSI (International Container Terminal Services, Inc.); a leading transportation and port services conglomerate in the Philippines.

This tournament attracts participation from numerous golfers worldwide. You can also register to participate.

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship occurs at Caliraya Springs Golf and Country Club; a venue on Caliraya Lake in Laguna province, Philippines. This golf course has many interesting natural scenes and unique architecture.

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship brings joy and excitement to participating golfers. It contributes to developing the sport of golf in the Philippines and raises awareness of Caliraya Springs Golf Course.

These are the five major renowned golf tournaments in the Philippines that we would like to introduce to you. We hope you will have a satisfying choice for your upcoming Philippine golf tour.
